_readme: Explicit-content rules for archive songs. 'words': matched as whole words in title, artist, album, tags and description; a trailing * matches any ending (fuck* -> fucking). 'phrases': matched anywhere (case-insensitive). 'artists': exact artist names (case-insensitive). 'ids': Typesense song ids excluded by hand (npm run exclude-song -- <id>). Ingestion skips matches and removes them from the index; the game also filters these ids out of every search.
